title: 第5章 俺爹就是一个文弱书生你让他去治水第6章 今天这县令是抽了什么风
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了
content_zh:
;;
两个少年一前一后走了进来。
走在前面的是杨蛟，他已经到了十八九岁的年纪，他浑身上下透着一股朴实劲儿，生得浓眉大眼。
身子已经长开了，肩宽背阔，一张脸被晒成小麦色，裤腿卷到膝盖以上，露出两条沾满泥巴的小腿。
他一进门就看见堂屋里坐着的杨易，脚步顿了一下，随即大步走上前去，二话不说，扑通一声就跪了下来。
“阿爹！”
杨蛟跪在地上，额头磕在青石板上，“儿子杨蛟，给爹爹请安！”
杨易放下筷子，看着跪在地上的大儿子，眼眶微微泛红，他走过去把杨蛟扶起来，上上下下打量了一番，拍了拍他的肩膀。
“好小子，长这么高了。”
杨蛟咧嘴一笑，露出一口白牙：“阿爹，您可算回来了。”
杨戬比杨蛟小两岁，也到了十七岁，身子没有哥哥那么壮实，却自有一股子凌厉的劲儿，他眉眼生得极好，剑眉斜飞，目若朗星。
他站在门口没有上前，只是看着杨易，那眼神里透着一丝藏得很深的怨气。
“怎么，不认识爹了？”
杨易瞅了一眼门口的杨戬，这家伙虽然也是一身泥巴，哪怕穿着粗布衣裳，骨子里也透出几分矜贵。
杨戬没说话，只是抿了抿嘴，把脸别到一边去。
杨蛟急忙推了杨戬一把，“二弟，还不快给父亲行礼！”
谁知道杨戬这小子兜着手，也不看杨易，还说道：“都离开十年了，居然还能认得出家门在哪里。”
杨易撸起袖子，一把就揪住了杨戬的耳朵，疼得杨戬龇牙咧嘴，“你小子翅膀硬了是吧，竟然教训起你老子来了？”
“哎哎哎，轻点，轻点，我到底也是你亲生的。”
杨易手上又加了一分力，杨戬疼得直抽冷气，却不敢挣开，只能歪着脑袋原地转圈。

“你老子我在外面拼死拼活，是为了谁？还特么连家门都不知道在哪里？老子以前教你的规矩你都塞泥腿子里了？”
“好了，好了，二郎还不快给你爹见礼。”
瑶姬这个时候走了上来，还给杨婵使了一个眼神，杨婵急忙过来抱着杨易的小腿，这个时候杨易这才松了手，瑶姬拉着杨戬坐在了杨易的旁边。
杨戬还有一点倔强，捂着耳朵，嘀嘀咕咕道：“都十年了，也不知道中间捎个信回来。”
见到杨易的巴掌又扬了起来，杨戬急忙说道：“哎哎哎，这是你说的，吃饭的时候不能打人！”
“你特么不还没吃饭吗？”
杨易一巴掌盖在了他的头上，“你老子我在那上京城中跟人斗智斗勇，脑袋别在裤腰带上，捎信回来让你们担心？”
杨戬委屈巴巴的看着杨易，道：“阿爹你不讲武德。”
杨易咧嘴一笑，道：“别哔哔了，快点去洗洗吃饭，你老子我忙了一天，饿得前胸贴后背了。”
杨蛟在旁边看得目瞪口呆，想笑又不敢笑，只能拼命憋着，杨婵可不管那么多，“咯咯咯”地笑出了声。
晚饭过后，杨婵入睡了之后，杨易早早的就收拾好了，正准备嘘嘘一个搂着自己的美娇妻好好霍霍一番。
刚从茅房出来，就听到了杨戬在那里议论自己。

Two teenagers walked in one after the other.
Walking in front was Yang Jiao, who was already eighteen or nineteen years old. He exuded a down-to-earth energy and had thick eyebrows and big eyes.
His body has grown longer, with broad shoulders and a broad back. His face is tanned to a wheat color, and his trouser legs are rolled up above his knees, revealing two muddy calves.
As soon as he entered the door, he saw Yang Yi sitting in the hall. He paused for a moment, then strode forward, and without saying a word, he knelt down with a plop.
"Abba!"
Yang Jiao knelt on the ground and knocked his forehead on the bluestone. "Son, Yang Jiao, please say hello to daddy!"
Yang Yi put down his chopsticks and looked at his eldest son kneeling on the ground, his eyes slightly red. He walked over and helped Yang Jiao up, looked up and down, and patted his shoulder.
"What a boy, you've grown so tall."
Yang Jiao grinned, showing his white teeth: "Dad, you are finally back."
Yang Jian is two years younger than Yang Jiao, and is also seventeen years old. He is not as strong as his brother, but he has a fierce energy.
He stood at the door and did not come forward. He just looked at Yang Yi, with a trace of deep resentment in his eyes.
"What, you don't know dad anymore?"
Yang Yi glanced at Yang Jian at the door. Although this guy was covered in mud, even though he was wearing coarse clothes, he still had a bit of dignity in his bones.
Yang Jian didn't speak, just pursed his lips and turned his face away.
Yang Jiao hurriedly pushed Yang Jian, "Second brother, hurry up and salute your father!"
Who would have thought that Yang Jian, this kid, had his hands in his arms and didn't even look at Yang Yi, and said, "I've been away for ten years, but I can still recognize where my home is."
Yang Yi rolled up his sleeves and grabbed Yang Jian's ears. The pain made Yang Jian grimace, "You have strong wings, right? You actually taught me a lesson?"
"Hey, hey, be gentle, be gentle, I am your biological child after all."
Yang Yi put more force on his hand. Yang Jian gasped in pain, but he didn't dare to move away. He could only tilt his head and spin in circles.
"For whom are you, me, and I working so hard outside? Why don't you even know where your home is? Have you swallowed all the rules I taught you before?"
"Okay, okay, Erlang, hurry up and give your father a present."
Yao Ji came up at this time and gave Yang Chan a look. Yang Chan hurriedly came over and hugged Yang Yi's calf. Only then did Yang Yi let go. Yao Ji pulled Yang Jian and sat next to Yang Yi.
Yang Jian was still a little stubborn. He covered his ears and muttered: "It's been ten years, and I don't know if a message will come back in the meantime."
Seeing Yang Yi's slap raised again, Yang Jian hurriedly said: "Hey, hey, this is what you said, you can't hit people while eating!"
"Haven't you eaten yet?"
Yang Yi slapped him on the head, "You and I are fighting wits and courage with people in the capital, with my head pinned to my belt, and I'm sending a message back to make you worry?"
Yang Jian looked at Yang Yi aggrievedly and said, "Dad, you don't have martial ethics."
Yang Yi grinned and said, "Stop beeping, go wash up and eat quickly. I've been busy all day, and I'm so hungry that my chest touches my back."
Yang Jiao was stunned as he watched beside him. He wanted to laugh but didn't dare to laugh, so he could only hold it in with all his strength. Yang Chan didn't care so much and burst out laughing.
After dinner, after Yang Chan fell asleep, Yang Yi had packed up early and was about to pee on his beautiful wife who was hugging him.
As soon as he came out of the hut, he heard Yang Jian talking about him.
